- issue_comment created in `venue-repo`#2 ("Venue choice and budget for the outline") by `venue-repo`  > **Venue: NeurIPS 2026 Main Track** (newest NeurIPS call published; template `neurips_2026.sty`, `ht-role venue neurips --template DIR`). Full record in `venue.md` (commit on `main`), sources in `venue/neurips-2026-library.md`.
  > 
  > - **Main-text limit**: 9 content pages **including all figures and tables**, one column (text block 5.5 x 9 in, Times 10 pt). Over-length is not reviewed.
  > - **Do not count**: references, appendices, the checklist (no page limit on any; one PDF, max 50 MB). Reviewers need not read the appendix, so everything a claim rests on goes in the 9 pages.
  > - **Checklist**: mandatory, 16 items from `template/checklist.tex`, in the PDF after references/appendix; missing = desk rejection. Several items need facts from analysis (compute resources, seeds/statistical significance, code and data access, licences of MMLU-Pro and the model, LLM-use declaration) — keep those on hand in outline §5.
  > - **Limit on figures/tables**: none stated, only the 9 pages. Sample of six NeurIPS main-track papers on neighbouring topics (`accepted-papers.md`): 3–6 figures and 0–4 tables in the main text, 23–91 references, 135–181-word abstracts. Floats must be at most about 2 of the 9 pages.
  > - **Budget I recommend**: main text **Fig 1–5 + Tab 1–2** is feasible if each figure is at most about 2.3 in high at full width (5.5 in) and the tables are short; that leaves about 7 pages of text. Fig 6 and Tab 3 to the appendix, as your outline already has it. Cut order if text overflows: Tab 1 to the appendix first, then merge Fig 5 into Fig 4 as panels. Appendix: 10–15 pages is normal and unlimited.
  > - **Type sizes for presentation**: figure text not below 7 pt as printed (8 pt preferred); `\footnotesize` is 8 pt in the style; full-width float = 5.5 in, two panels ~2.7 in each; no vertical rules in tables (`booktabs`); captions state the take-away; figures must read in black and white; embed Type 1/TrueType fonts (matplotlib `pdf.fonttype 42`).
  > - **Anonymity**: double blind; code is an anonymised ZIP up to 100 MB; no acknowledgments; own work in third person.
  > - **Reviewers**: Quality, Clarity, Significance, Originality (1–4 each), overall 1–6; "originality does not require a new method".
  > 
  > Not settled: the exact delivered paths (PDF, code ZIP) — I am asking paper-repo. Closing this request as answered.
